## My Interactive Visualizations Portfolio

```{r echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
user <- "aakritixyz"
repos <- c(
  "ten-points-animint", "iris-animint-test", "worldbank-animint-test", 
  "kmeans-animint-test", "mc-sample-mean-test", "buffon-needle-test", 
  "rosling-bubbles-test"
)

cat("| Screenshot | Project Title | Links |\n")
cat("|:---:|:---|:---|\n")

for(repo in repos){
  # Building the strings carefully
  img_url  <- paste0("[https://raw.githubusercontent.com/](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/)", user, "/", repo, "/main/Capture.PNG")
  demo_url <- paste0("https://", user, ".github.io/", repo, "/")
  code_url <- paste0("[https://github.com/](https://github.com/)", user, "/", repo)
  
  # Formatting name
  name <- gsub("-animint|-test", "", repo)
  name <- toupper(name)

  # Writing the row
  cat(paste0("| <img src='", img_url, "' width='250'> | **", name, "** | [Demo](", demo_url, ") <br> [Source](", code_url, ") |\n"))
}
